newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-BAYERN LOSE ZIEGE TO AC MILAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BAYERN LOSE ZIEGE TO AC MILAN.

text.p: Bayern Munich's international wing back Christian Ziege is to join AC Milan at the end of the season.

While Germany's Euro 96 player, currently on a short tour to Scotland with Bayern, continued to deny rumours that he had signed for the Italian team, Bayern's commercial manager Uli Hoeness on Tuesday confirmed the deal had been sealed.
"He has informed us that he has signed a four-year contract with AC Milan," Hoeness told reporters in Munich before leaving for Britain.
It has been known for several months that Ziege wanted to leave Bayern who he joined as an 18-year-old in 1990.
He has been reportedly taking an intensive course in Italian.
